source.title: Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. Returned unopposed. Two seats; the retiring members were William White and Robert Hazelton. "Only two gentlemen ... were nominated, therefore no election ... will take place." M'Geagh was chairman of Lurgan Urban Council. Labels from the Frontier Sentinel (29 April 1905, p. 8).
